concerns.text: The plan states FR‑007 ‘Evaluate on a downstream long‑context QA task (HotpotQA subset)’ but cites the dataset URL `https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/long-qa`. The cited dataset (Long‑QA) is a distinct resource from the original HotpotQA benchmark. This mismatch creates ambiguity about which dataset will actually be used and whether it satisfies the long‑context requirement (≥ 32 k tokens). Clarify the exact dataset name, ensure the chosen dataset provides contexts of the required length, and update the citation to match the dataset that will be used for evaluation.
